slices.behaviour: Everything a subagent reads tells it to declare its model with --model, and a slice window is bounded by the plan and closed at the first advance after it, so a rework round is charged to no slice rather than to the last one.
slices.failure_reason: Quoted from check 60's captured output: "AssertionError: Lists differ: [1, 2, 3, 4] != [1, 2]" for the windows keyed past the end of the plan; "AssertionError: 12 != 13 : the first tdd advance is the boundary", which was this session's own expectation being wrong rather than the code, and is corrected in the test; "AssertionError: '--model sonnet' not found in 'Work slice 1 of SEEN-001: The status line...'" and "AssertionError: '--model opus' not found in 'Work slice 1 of SEEN-001: Fee expectations...'" for the spawn text; and "AssertionError: '--model' not found in" both the implementer's source and its generated copy.
